description: This PHP class 'CalendarDisplay' handles the rendering and interaction logic for a calendar module within a SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM-based project. It manages displaying calendar views, headers, footers, activity colors, and shared views, along with converting PHP date formats to Moment.js formats. It also references external template files for UI rendering.

classes.name: CalendarDisplay
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering and managing the display of a calendar in the SuiteCRM environment, including UI components, event handling, and format conversions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the CalendarDisplay object with a Calendar instance, optional dashlet ID, and views.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main function to render the calendar UI, including assigning variables to templates and loading sub-templates.

methods.name: checkActivity
methods.description: Checks and merges activity color configurations and user preferences for calendar activity types.

methods.name: load_settings_template
methods.description: Loads the settings popup template for calendar configuration.

methods.name: get_date_info
methods.description: Returns a string describing the date range or specific date based on current view and date for display purposes.

methods.name: get_next_calendar
methods.description: Generates HTML link to navigate to the next date range in the calendar.

methods.name: get_previous_calendar
methods.description: Generates HTML link to navigate to the previous date range in the calendar.

methods.name: display_calendar_header
methods.description: Displays the calendar header, including navigation buttons and controls.

methods.name: display_calendar_footer
methods.description: Displays the footer for the calendar view.

methods.name: convertPHPToMomentFormat
methods.description: Converts PHP date format strings into Moment.js compatible format strings.

methods.name: display_title
methods.description: Outputs the module title and add-item dropdown for mobile or standard views.

methods.name: display_shared_html
methods.description: Outputs HTML for shared view options and interactive elements.
